02 / About me

ABOUT_DANIEL.txt− □ ×

~/people/daniel

Curious by nature.
Focused on building.

I’m an Information Technology student at the Technical University of Moldova who learns by turning ideas into working projects. My work includes a vehicle inspection website and a fitness equipment storefront, with a focus on responsive layouts, clear navigation, and useful interactive features.

I enjoy breaking complex tasks into manageable steps, researching solutions, and refining the details that make a website easier to use. I bring curiosity, a structured approach to problem-solving, and a willingness to learn from feedback. I’m looking for an opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, develop alongside experienced colleagues, and take on increasing responsibility. I prefer remote work.
